title: Define a business brand review checklist
summary: Translate the requested modern business standards into a review checklist for claims, distinctiveness, accessible use, asset rights, and distribution.

origin.source: Owner requested a list of modern business standards for the brand identity work

benefits: Gives teams one place to record evidence for practical brand use.
risks: A checklist could be misread as a certification without reviewing the underlying evidence.

evidence.claim: The release provides a starting surface for recorded review decisions.
